title: Container With Most Water
description: Given `n` non-negative integers `height` where each represents a point at coordinate `(i, height[i])`, find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container, such that the container contains the most water.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` integers.
output_format: Maximum area of water a container can store.
hints: Start with two pointers at the widest possible width: left = 0, right = n - 1.
The height is constrained by the shorter of the two lines.
Move the pointer pointing to the shorter line inward to search for larger heights.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    h = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    l, r = 0, n - 1
    mx = 0
    while l < r:
        mx = max(mx, min(h[l], h[r]) * (r - l))
        if h[l] < h[r]: l += 1
        else: r -= 1
    print(mx)
